purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 18-record item effect batch 017; together these files contain exactly 18 self-contained reviewed records.

items/shield-of-the-resolute-628.name: Shield of the Resolute [Relic]
items/shield-of-the-resolute-628.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, neutral-good, or lawful-neutral wielder, the shield functions as a +1 light-fortification heavy mithral shield. With the relic connection to Moradin, goblinoids and giants within 30 feet that see it must save Will DC 17 at the start of their turns or be shaken if their Hit Dice are at least the wielder's, or frightened if lower, for 2 rounds; after failing once, that creature is immune to this power for 24 hours.

items/shroud-of-night.name: Shroud of Night
items/shroud-of-night.effectSummary: The normal shroud continuously grants +2 deflection AC and can use dancing shadows and shadow skin on the wearer once per day each. The greater version grants +3 deflection AC and additionally allows voyage into shadow on the wearer once per day.

items/spiralburst-bottle.name: Spiralburst Bottle
items/spiralburst-bottle.effectSummary: Opening or shattering the bottle creates a tiny Ethereal portal that targets the opener or the object struck by the thrown bottle. Unless the target succeeds on Fortitude DC 30, the portal pulls up to 10 cubic feet of it through in one round; most creatures die instantly unless amorphous, ordinary rigid objects are destroyed, and surviving matter is left on the Ethereal Plane. The portal disappears after this single use.

items/survival-pouch.name: Survival Pouch
items/survival-pouch.effectSummary: Five times per day, as a standard action, the pouch can produce one listed survival resource for up to 8 hours unless otherwise noted: daily rations, two gallons of water, a tent and two bedrolls, 50 feet of rope for 4 hours, a shovel, a campfire that can become eight torches, a +1-Strength composite shortbow with 20 arrows, or a fully equipped mule. Any combination of up to five choices can be drawn each day.

items/talisman-transference-522.name: Talisman of Transference
items/talisman-transference-522.effectSummary: The wearer links the talisman to the raw material of one planned magic item with the command 'attach' before construction, then after at least 8 hours of work touches the creator and says 'infuse.' It can then transfer some or all of the item's required XP cost from the wearer to the creator, never more than the construction cost; attaching new raw material replaces the previous link.

items/tattoo-avatar-787.name: Tattoo Avatar
items/tattoo-avatar-787.effectSummary: The avatar can hold up to seventeen movable psionic tattoos, which become inert while stored on it. A psionic creature in physical contact can spend 1 power point to awaken a stored tattoo and move it onto its body; moving tattoos either onto or off the avatar requires physical contact.

items/teleporting-682.name: Teleporting
items/teleporting-682.effectSummary: This property can be placed only on throwable weapons. In the round after the weapon is thrown, just before the thrower's next turn, it returns through the Astral Plane to the thrower's empty hand so it is ready to use again.

items/thurible-of-divining.name: Thurible of Divining
items/thurible-of-divining.effectSummary: While filled with burning incense, the thurible produces prayer continuously. Its wielder can trigger detect magic, detect good, or detect law in any combination totaling three uses per day; augury or locate object once per day; divination or true seeing once per week; and commune once per month.

items/tome-of-ancient-lore-606.name: Tome of Ancient Lore [Relic]
items/tome-of-ancient-lore-606.effectSummary: A qualifying neutral-aligned arcane spellcaster who studies the tome for 1 hour gains +5 competence on Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft checks for that day. With the relic connection to Boccob, once per day while preparing spells the caster can prepare one arcane spell not in their spellbook, with a 50% chance to find a spell of the highest level they can cast and a 100% chance for any lower-level spell they can cast.
